SCAN_DOCUMENTS.doc: The documents a plugin scan writes, named here and owned elsewhere: the contract names them so the writers and readers cite one word, and keeps no shape of its own for them.
SCAN_DOCUMENTS.why: omx-clap-core and plugin-qualify write one scan document (FreeMixer/omx-contract#157).

clapScanDocument.doc: The JSON document of omx-clap-scan, one entry per file with its plugins, parameters and ports. Owned by omx-clap-core, which writes it; its shape is omx-clap-core's reference.

fieldDump.doc: The field dump of omx-clap-scan --fields: the line `# omx-clap-scan --fields 1`, the format's version, then one `<scope> TAB <field> TAB <value>` record per field a plugin states. Its scopes are SCAN_FIELD_SCOPES.

SCAN_FIELD_SCOPES.doc: The scopes of a field dump record, as written before the first TAB; an indexed scope is followed by `:<index>`. Named here, owned by plugin-qualify: the owner keeps the code that writes and reads them.

param.doc: a CLAP parameter, indexed in get_info order

port.doc: an LV2 port, indexed by lv2:index

panel.doc: the panel description of a plugin that serves org.openmixer.panel-description/1: its family and fingerprint

section.doc: a section of the panel description, indexed

control.doc: a control of the panel description, indexed

role.doc: a role of the panel description, indexed

display.doc: a display of the panel description, indexed

placementDefault.doc: a per-placement come-up value of the panel description, indexed
